title: EPGC in Applied AI & Machine Learning | IIT Kharagpur Online
description: # Executive Post Graduate Certificate in Applied AI & Machine Learning. A comprehensive postgraduate online programme designed and delivered by the Department of Artificial Intelligence, IIT Kharagpur. The curriculum is thoughtfully structured to take learners from strong AI foundations to advanced, real-world applications, covering Machine Learning, Deep Learning, NLP, Generative AI, and deployment practices. Drawing from IIT Kharagpur’s academic depth and research excellence, this programme prepares learners to build, deploy, and operate AI systems with confidence, developing the skills needed to apply AI effectively across real-world business and engineering contexts. ## From Foundations to Gen AI & Agentic AI led by IIT Kharagpur’s Artificial Intelligence Department. End to End learning led by professors from the Department of Artificial Intelligence. ### Foundations to GenAI, Agentic AI & Deployment. AI Foundations Bridge → ML & Deep Learning → NLP & Transformers → GenAI → Agentic AI → RAG → Deployment & MLOps. ## An End-to-End AI Engineering programme: The Full-Stack AI Engineering Curriculum.
